parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the Cloud Firewall member accounts.

parameters.name: VpcFirewallId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

- If the VPC firewall protects network instances in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, the instance ID is the CEN instance ID. For CEN Basic Edition, call the [DescribeVpcFirewallCenList](~~345777~~) operation to query the CEN instance ID. For CEN Enterprise Edition, call the [DescribeTrFirewallsV2List](~~2384695~~) operation to query the CEN instance ID.
- If the VPC firewall protects traffic between two VPCs connected through Express Connect, the instance ID is the VPC firewall instance ID. Call the [DescribeVpcFirewallList](~~342932~~) operation to query the VPC firewall instance ID.
